settlement_source: Contract terms name the state government of Florida as Source Agency (API lists usa.gov/state-governments). In practice accelerated resolution uses media decision-desk calls.
settlement_variable: Party of person sworn in as governor of Florida pursuant to the 2026 election (GOVPARTY terms). Party switch between election and swearing-in: party on election day counts. Vacancy before seating: party of first person sworn in as replacement.
trading_close_vs_settlement: Last Trading Time = Expiration Time. Expiration = sooner of first 10:00 AM ET after governor swearing-in or 1 year after the popular vote; settlement no later than day after expiration unless under review. Accelerated: resolves early when >=4 of 8 Designated Media Sources (NYT, AP, DDHQ, CNN, Fox, NBC, CBS, ABC) declare a winner and none contradict. API close_time 2027-11-03 is nominal; can_close_early=1; settlement_timer_seconds=14.
early_close_or_void_clauses: Accelerated determination by 4/8 media consensus (an unambiguous news-article statement also counts; affiliates count with parent network; national desk supersedes). Exchange may replace a media source at sole discretion. Kalshi may start Market Outcome Review (Rule 6.3(c)) at sole discretion before settlement. Revisions after Expiration ignored.
title_vs_rules_divergences: Title 'win the governorship' vs rules: payout is on person SWORN IN, not election winner; only the accelerated media-call path settles near election time.
Accelerated path settles on projections, not certification; a call later reversed before swearing-in would already have settled.
yes_sub_title names a candidate but contract is party-based; candidate replacement/withdrawal does not change it.
API close_time (2027) is a nominal max date; real resolution is via accelerated determination or expiry.

public_feeds_for_settlement_variable.name: CNN / Fox / NBC / CBS / ABC decision desks

notes: Today (2026-11-03) is election day: highest information-asymmetry window. Settlement timer 14s after accelerated trigger; fast-feed latency (AP/DDHQ API vs web) is the edge/toxicity axis. Terms are shared across all states (GOVPARTY.pdf); state recount/certification law not covered. Prohibited-trader list includes vote-tallying staff and decision-desk employees.
